entities.summary: Shin-ichi Sakamoto (b. 1972-07-19, Osaka) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Osaka and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
